overview: Stalgasin Hive is a industrial hive spire on Geonosis, documented across Films · Clone Wars. Stalgasin Hive on Geonosis hosted droid foundries and the Petranaki arena where Count Dooku executed Separatist leadership summons.
history:

Stalgasin Hive grew where Geonosis's resources—water, ore, kyber, or trade lanes—forced travelers to stop, creating a industrial hive spire that outlasted first founders. Early survey maps from the Old Republic era list Stalgasin Hive as a mandatory customs point for sector governors and Jedi exploration teams. Films, Clone Wars, Rebels, Mandalorian, Ahsoka, KOTOR, KOTOR II, TOR, and Sith Empire narratives all treat Stalgasin Hive as more than scenery—it is a decision point.

Ancient and pre-Republic layers beneath Stalgasin Hive include buried fortresses, Rakatan relics, and Sith ward-stones that still disrupt modern sensors. Pre-Republic and Sith-era layers beneath Stalgasin Hive include ward-stones, Rakatan markers, and Massassi masonry that modern engineers still discover during repaving. Stalgasin Hive has been invaded, liberated, blockaded, and rebuilt more times than most planetary capitals, making its streets a palimpsest of battle damage. Battle dossiers from KOTOR sieges, TOR planetary incursions, and Galactic Civil War raids mark Stalgasin Hive as strategically contested on Geonosis. Clone Wars dossiers mark Stalgasin Hive as strategically vital; Imperial Era governors exploited that same geography to punish rebellious populations. KOTOR-era records and TOR-era campaign logs show earlier iterations of the same struggle—control of Stalgasin Hive meant control of Geonosis.
